operation.summary: Run a remote command with this connection's exec permission; can be scheduled

body.name: connection
body.description: This agent's saved SSH connection id

body.name: command
body.description: Remote shell command, 1..32768 characters; no automatic sudo

body.name: timeout_seconds
body.description: Total connect + operation deadline, 1..120 seconds; default 30. Disconnect does not guarantee remote termination.

body.name: stdin
body.description: UTF-8 standard input, up to 512 KiB; EOF follows

body.name: cwd
body.description: Optional working directory; requires POSIX remote shell; safely quoted

body.name: env
body.description: Up to 64 SSH environment requests. Remote server AcceptEnv policy controls acceptance.

body.name: pty
body.description: Request a pseudo-terminal; default false. May merge stderr and alter output. Not an interactive session.

body.name: max_output_bytes
body.description: 1..1048576 per stream, default 65536. Extra output is drained and discarded.

operation.returns: exit_code (null if unknown),stdout,stderr,stdout_truncated,stderr_truncated,timed_out=false,pty; transport/deadline/revocation errors include ssh_error; remote effects may continue after disconnect
